abilities.desc_zh:
阿尔茜总是想保护她的队友，对有威胁的对手发动强大的攻击。

所有特殊技：{{var_8}} 的概率获得精确增益，增加 {{var_9}} 的暴击率并在 {{var_10}} 秒内防止对手规避。
abilities.desc_en:
Always wanting to protect her fellow teammates, Arcee strikes powerful attacks against threatening opponents.

Special Attacks: {{var_8}} Chance to gain a Precision Buff, increasing Critical Rate by {{var_9}} and preventing the opponent from Evading attacks for {{var_10}} seconds.
